newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujisawa to sell antidepressant drug.
newsitem.headline: Fujisawa to sell antidepressant drug.

text.p: Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Monday it had obtained the right to sell the antidepressant drug fluvoxamine maleate in Japan from Solvay Seiyaku KK, the Japanese unit of Solvay SA, a Brussels-based chemicals and pharmaceuticals firm.
The antidepressant drug was jointly developed in Japan by Solvay Meiji Yakuhin KK, a joint venture between Solvay and Meiji Seika Kaisha Ltd, and Meiji Seika.
In March 1996, they jointly submitted an application to the Ministry of Health and Welfare for permission to produce and sell the drug in Japan.
The drug will be sold to hospitals.

Fujisawa hopes to start selling the drug in the middle of next year with an annual sales target of four billion to five billion yen, a Fujisawa spokesman said. Meiji Seika will also sell the drug separately.
